title: Dave Canales on Xavier Legette: Really good to see him back to playing like himself

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dave Canales on Xavier Legette: Really good to see him back to playing like himself
sources.description: Panthers wide receiver Xavier Legette said in June that he "can’t have another year like I did last year" and the work he's done to turn things around has paid some dividends this summer.
